deployment_threshold_after_oof.definition: median of the five independently selected outer-fold thresholds
deployment_threshold_after_oof.role: train-only deployment candidate; not the OOF performance estimate

exact_scan.candidate_construction_per_outer_fold: Use only the four development folds. Take sorted unique finite r_hh_125_125 values from authorized primary rows; construct strict-cut candidates with numpy.nextafter(value, +infinity), plus a zero-selection lower sentinel.
exact_scan.candidate_count_limit: at most one plus the number of unique development-set r_hh_125_125 values
exact_scan.continuous_scan_interpretation: For a strict one-dimensional threshold, empirical selection changes only when the threshold crosses an observed value. Scanning all observed event boundaries is therefore exact on the finite train sample and avoids an arbitrary coarse grid.

for_outer_fold_k.threshold_candidate_source: unlabeled r_hh_125_125 values in development rows only
